## Checklist

- [ ] A stranger can re-run this with no credentials, no absolute paths, no files outside the repo.
- [ ] If this adds a check, there is a **negative control** that goes red — or a stated reason why
      one is impossible.
- [ ] `BLOCKED` / `SKIP` were not made to look like `PASS`, and `BLOCKED` was not rewritten into `FAIL`.
- [ ] `aitb demo` is green and `aitb selftest` exits 1 on my machine.
- [ ] If I claim "verified", the `manifest.json` hash of that run is pasted below.
